programRules.name: Oxygen Saturation (SpO2) (%) warning
programRules.description: Low oxygen saturation: urgent clinical assessment; verify the reading.

programRules.name: Systolic BP (mmHg) warning
programRules.description: Severe-range systolic BP: assess immediately per clinical protocol.

programRules.name: Systolic BP (mmHg) warning
programRules.description: Very high systolic BP: assess for hypertensive emergency.

programRules.name: Glycated Haemoglobin (HbA1c) (%) warning
programRules.description: Check implausibly high HbA1c result and clinical interpretation.

programRules.name: Weight (kg) warning
programRules.description: Weight must be greater than zero.

programRules.name: Heart rate (per min) warning
programRules.description: Heart rate must be greater than zero.

programRules.name: Gestational age weeks warning
programRules.description: Verify gestational age. Value exceeds typical pregnancy duration.
